Q: If the pant's hems are at ankles(below the ankles) can they be folded before performing Namaz? A: If pant's bottoms are at ankle it is not allowed to fold them to perform namaz, perform the Namaz without folding them. If pant's hems are kept below ankles because of pride, it is HARAM, in this case Namaz will be Makrooh-e-Tehreemi (Wajib to repeat Namaz) otherwise it's only Makrooh-e-Tanzeehi which is Khilafe Aula in Namaz. Same is written in Fatawa-e-Rizvia in part three on page 448. In case of folding the pants hems in Namaz will definitely be Makrooh-e-Tehreemi which will make it Wajib to perform the Namaz again. It's in Hadees *. Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihe Wasslam said:" I was ordered that not to fold hair and cloth (In Namaz)" ted in Darr-e-Mukhtar with Shami Part one page 473. art one, Page 137)-Allah Ta'ala Knows the best. 5161 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8671 Country: Canada Title: How often should one apply itr? How often should one apply oil to one's hair? Is it permissible to comb one's hair everyday? Question: How often should one apply itr? How often should one apply oil to one's hair? Is it permissible to comb one's hair everyday? Answer ID: 8671 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1470/1225=L/1429) (1) There is no limit. (2) It is mentioned in Hadith, used to apply so much oil that his head cloth used to be like the cloth of oilman. (Jam?ul Wasaail 1:103) (3) One is allowed to comb hair daily if needed, but it is undesirable to pay so much attention to it: واما حدیث النھی عن الترجل الا غباً فالمراد بہ ترک المبالغۃ فی الترفہ المشعر بانھا من ھوی النفس والمشیر بانھا فی تنظیف الباطن اولی ( جمع الوسائل 1:99 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
